general.note: Stronger in bio/life-science research than its reputation suggests (marine bio, biochem). Same Oregon caveat: no on-site medical center. WUE caveat: at OSU the WUE rate is a COMPETITIVE SCHOLARSHIP, not a guaranteed discount every WUE-state applicant gets — OSU's own WUE page states only about 30% of students from WUE-eligible states will be offered the WUE Scholarship. Plan on the full non-resident cost of attendance ($65,013/yr, 2026-27) unless the award actually lands. OSU publishes no WUE dollar figure; the policy is 150% of resident tuition, so the ~$24,102/yr base-tuition number is a DERIVED ESTIMATE, not an official published figure. Resident COA for reference is $38,568/yr (2026-27).
general.medNote: Good Plan B breadth (bioengineering, public health).

wueDetail.basis: OSU's WUE award is a competitive scholarship, not an automatic rate: its own page states only about 30% of students from WUE-eligible states will be offered the WUE Scholarship. Confirmed via admissions.oregonstate.edu/wue, 2026-09-05.
wueDetail.estDerivation: ~$24,102/yr base tuition = 150% of resident base tuition, as computed in data/PENDING-RESEARCH-2026-09-05.md B2. The resident base-tuition input is not published in any local file, so this figure is carried forward as-is rather than re-derived here. Not an official OSU number.
wueDetail.coaSrcNote: Non-resident $65,013 (tuition+fees $42,459 + housing/food $18,066) is sourced to the OSU financial aid cost-of-attendance page via data/verify-batch1-west.json. The resident $38,568 figure comes from data/PENDING-RESEARCH-2026-09-05.md B2 with no accompanying URL — logged in GAPS.md, treated as disclosed-unsourced, not as a published sourced number.
